sentences.text: The F.I.R. of this case was lodged by the mother of deceased against the three named accused including the present petitioner with these allegations that her daughter Anita Hansda was married with Ishwar Soren.

After the marriage her daughter was tortured by her husband Ishwar Soren,
father-in-law Renta Soren and mother-in-law Raymuni Soren.
On 02.03.2024 at 02:41 a phone call came on the mobile phone of the son of informant from the mobile of her daughter on which the message was sent that not to spare her husband.
Thereafter the son of informant called her sister back but same was not received and after sometime phone came switched off.
Her son reached to the inlaws house of her sister and found her dead and it was told by Ishwar Soren that she committed suicide.
The daughter of the informant was also pregnant of five months.
Hence this F.I.R. was lodged.

4. The informant Fulo Hansda in her restatement has reiterated the allegations made in the F.I.R.
Bisu Hansda son of informant has stated that on his mobile phone his sister had sent the message Ishwar Soren @ Iswar Soren Aged About 30 ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ... Opp. ... on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139042236/
1 not to spare her husband and when he again called her back, same was not received despite calling her thrice.

sentences.text: On reaching to the in-laws house, he found his sister dead.
Lusku Hansda the father of deceased also corroborated the prosecution story.
5. Jasmi Soren has stated that she has received the phone call of the brother of Anita Hansda who had asked her to see Anita Hansda to talk with him.
She went to the room of Anita Hansda.
The persons of locality also came there and on being peeped, it was found that she had hanged herself.

The door was also broken after having kicked the same by the persons present at the spot and the deceased was brought down and she had hanged herself and was laid on the cot then her husband Ishwar Soren and father-in-law Renta Soren both were informed in regard to the commission of suicide by Anita Hansda.
Same kind of statement is given by Gurucharan Soren and Raymat Soren who happen to be neighbours of the matrimonial house of the deceased.
6. In postmortem report of deceased cause of death is shown asphyxia due to hanging and viscera was also preserved.
Report of the same is being awaited.
7. In view of the above, the bail petition of the petitioner is allowed.

Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court concerned in the aforesaid case.
